Choose a sufficiently small \(\rho_p(T)\)-invariant ball about zero on which \(\exp_p\) is injective; in its image the fixed set is exactly the image of the linear fixed subspace \((T_pM)^T\). These charts show that \(F\) is an embedded submanifold near every \(p\in F\) and \(T_pF=(T_pM)^T\). Since \(F\) is compact, its connected components are finite in number: its components are open in the manifold \(F\), so compactness gives a finite subcover by component neighborhoods.
